name: SBR token drain
summary: The freshly deployed SBR token exposed an unguarded balance-manipulation path that let an arbitrary caller strip the SBR/WETH Uniswap V2 pair of its SBR reserve, resync the pair and sell into the drained pool for the pair's WETH.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
